name: HostAway Connector
author: 610 Web Lab

sections.description:
HostAway Connector seamlessly integrates your WordPress website with your Hostaway account.

The plugin displays real-time property listings, availability calendars, and allows visitors to book directly from your website using the official Hostaway API.

No listing, availability, or booking data is stored locally on your server. All data is fetched dynamically, ensuring accuracy, performance, and security.

Key Features

  • Display Hostaway listings with images and details
  • Show real-time availability calendars
  • Enable direct booking via Hostaway API
  • Lightweight and fully API-driven
  • No local data storage

Pro Version

The Pro version of HostAway Connector adds advanced features for professional hosts and property managers.

Pro Features

  • Enable booking functionality with payment integration
  • Advanced listing filters for improved search experience
  • Display guest reviews on single listing pages
  • Google Maps integration for listing location views
  • View and manage reservations from the WordPress admin area

Upgrade to Pro

Learn more about the Pro version and pricing

Third-Party Services

This plugin connects to the Hostaway API (API Documentation) to:

Data Accessed

  • Property listings and images
  • Availability and pricing calendars
  • Booking and reservation submissions
  • Cancellation policy details

API Endpoints Used

  • /v1/listings/
  • /v1/listings/{listingID}
  • /v1/listings/{listingID}/calendar
  • /v1/listings/{listingID}/calendar/priceDetails
  • /v1/reservations/
  • /v1/cancellationPolicies/{cancellationPolicyId}

Authentication

All API requests require an OAuth 2.0 access token.

The plugin retrieves the access token using your Client ID and Client Secret and includes it in all requests using the following header:

Authorization: Bearer ACCESS_TOKEN

No personal or booking data is stored locally.

Hostaway Privacy Policy:
https://www.hostaway.com/privacy-policy/

External Services

HostAway Connector can optionally connect to a 610 Web Lab service to provide plugin-related support and service functionality.

When explicitly approved by the site administrator, the plugin may send:

  • Site URL
  • Administrator email address

This data is used solely for plugin-related support, service communication, and update-related purposes.

No data is sent automatically on plugin activation.
No data is shared without explicit administrator consent.

Plugin Service URL:
https://610weblab.com/hostaway-wordpress-connector/

Privacy Policy:
https://610weblab.com/privacy-policy/

Credits

Developed by 610 Web Lab
https://610weblab.com/about-us/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/hostaway-connector directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen.
  3. Navigate to Settings → HostAway to configure your API credentials.
  4. Use the shortcode [hostaway_listings] to display listings on any page.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin store any data locally?

No. All listing, availability, and booking data is retrieved in real time from the Hostaway API.

Do I need a Hostaway account?

Yes. An active Hostaway account with API access is required.

Can visitors book directly from my website?

Yes. Bookings are securely submitted through the Hostaway API.

Does it support Airbnb, Vrbo, or Booking.com?

Yes. Hostaway is a channel manager, so any channels synced in your Hostaway account (Airbnb, Vrbo, Booking.com, etc.) are automatically reflected.

Does the plugin send site data externally?

Only if the administrator explicitly approves the optional service connection. The plugin may send the site URL and administrator email for plugin-related support and service purposes.
